Name: DSC's Bus Reskin - British
Author: dragonsteincole
Description:
This is a reskin of the bus to give it a more modern appearance, based on a local bus livery from the south of London.

The advertisements on the side of the bus will change from day to day. Some are graphics pulled from the cut 'bus interior' map, the rest are custom.
There are also designs advertising upcoming festivals or events. These will be displayed a day in advance of the festival, and on the day(s) of the festival themselves. All vanilla festivals and events are currently supported.

This mod requires SMAPI and ContentPatcher to work.

Installation:
1. Ensure [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] are ﻿installed
2. Download this mod
3. Extract this mod to the Stardew Valley/Mods folder
